textRuns.value: MonitorRaw: raw monitor output in Import mode
This report reads the JSON files that monitor writes and does not call any API. Open Transform data > Edit parameters to configure the source.
SourceType: Local or Blob. Selects where the files are read from.

LocalFolder: absolute path of the folder that contains the module folders (activity, capacity_metrics, gitconnections, ...). Use the LOCAL_OUTPUT_PATH value, or a copy of the container root. Used when SourceType is Local.
BlobAccountUrl and BlobContainer: storage account URL and container name. Used when SourceType is Blob. Sign in with an account that has the Storage Blob Data Reader role.
BlobRootPath: the STORAGE_ACCOUNT_CONTAINER_ROOT_PATH value. Leave empty when the module folders sit at the container root.
Legacy dates come from <module>/YYYY/MM/DD/ folders (UTC), not file modified times. Fabric collections use <module>/YYYY/MM/DD/runId/ envelopes and UTC observedAt timestamps.
Capacity Metrics rows are de-duplicated: the latest run wins per capacity, group and timepoint. Carry-over data exists only for newer Capacity Metrics app versions.
Git connections, tags, delegated settings and widely shared links show the latest snapshot only. They are opt-in monitor modules and stay empty until the module has run.
Connections uses the latest complete healthy snapshot, including an empty success. Null names stay null; only report labels fall back to identity. Credentials and connection paths are never imported.

Deployment Pipelines uses the latest committed discovery, including empty success. Deployment Operations retains all stored history, latest observation per pipeline/operation. Coverage is caller-visible, not tenant-wide; history requires pipeline Admin. The API exposes up to 20 recent deployments per poll; polling gaps cannot be recovered.

Item Permissions uses one validated cycle: newest finished with successful observations (including empty success), else newest useful in-progress. No cross-cycle carry-forward. PARTIAL COVERAGE: grants show successful observations only; failed/unvisited targets do not mean no access. Newer attempts make older evidence stale; scope may differ. Not effective access; no Graph group expansion.

Fabric Job History retains latest observations per workspace/item/job, even for deselected targets. Explicit Notebook, DataPipeline and SparkJobDefinition targets only; polling gaps cannot be recovered. Scope shows latest finished-poll outcomes, possibly incomplete. Raw failure payloads excluded.

The diagnostics below cover all four Fabric collectors. Legacy parse failures appear in Load Error rows. Fabric malformed/missing artifacts count in Collection Status and Load Errors; manifests and gates are not facts. Disabled, unconfigured or never-run collectors show Not collected, not healthy zeroes. Check status and snapshot times before counts. This read-only report does not enable collection or select targets.
